dedupe_keys.name: scinda r ionosphere and positioning data preparation scripts

description: SCINDA-R-scripts converts SCINDA receiver output into one-minute ionosphere and positioning tables. The collaborators provide R scripts to read compressed SCN and PSN files, extract relative total electron content, scintillation and rate-of-TEC-change indices, and calculate position summaries. The associated article applies the scripts to Lisbon observations from 2014–2019, while the input format can serve other compatible receivers. GitHub provides the source free under GPL-3.0. The README specifies GPS-only filtering, satellite elevation thresholds and explicit missing epochs, with text DAT outputs. A setup limitation is that the README requests DOYall_hours_length.txt while the root inventory lists DOYall_hours.txt; this discrepancy requires checking before execution. A reviewer-assessed use is preparing GNSS disturbance inputs for navigation and communications simulations. data-scinda-lisbon-airport-gnss-ionosphere is the existing catalogue data record; the R scripts are distinct from its referenced MATLAB toolbox. No code, raw receiver archive or derived table was executed.
